qsel_repo: a clean clone of the reused runtime at tag qwen-select-prereg-v1

model_dirs.DS: directory of the pinned DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B files
model_dirs.QW: directory of the pinned Qwen3-8B files

gpu_uuid: edge: GPU-... of its GPU. server: null in the template; select-gpu writes the pinned copy
token_file: the experiment's own token for the REMOTE wire, mode 0600. The server preflight creates it; the edge gets a copy
workload_private: edge: the pinned private workload file (prompts, reference answers, token ids). server: null
hash_cache: a file of the experiment's own in which checkpoint hashes are cached
router_encoder_dir: edge: directory of the pinned all-MiniLM-L6-v2 files. server: null
